title: Seated Leg Curl
summary: A seated machine leg curl. Your hips are bent, so the hamstrings work from a longer stretch.

equipment_needs.text: Needs: seated leg curl machine or attachment.

muscles.why: Library rating 1 for hamstrings (main mover): each working set adds 1 of a set to the weekly hamstrings total.

setup.text: Sit with your knees lined up with the pivot, the pad behind your lower legs, and the thigh pad snug.
Curl your heels down and back.
Return slowly until your legs are straight.

form_cues.cue: Curl the pad down and under
Leaning forward adds stretch. Research suggests seated curls build more than lying curls.

mistakes.text: Letting the weight snap back up between reps.

lower_risk.text: Warm-up: the app adds no ramp-up sets; make the first working set a touch lighter if you like.
The app suggests a heavier load only when the jump is 10% or less; otherwise it adds a rep first.
Default target: 10-15 reps, stopping about 2 reps short of failure (RIR 2). Stop the set when form breaks down.
Use the same controlled range on every rep; lower under control rather than dropping or bouncing.
Pick a variation and range you can train comfortably.

alternatives.why: Swap sheet: Less stretch emphasis, One side at a time.
